text:
Lina (capacityops): Heads-up: we're opening an early access preview for the new NVIDIA G500X dedicated pools in auckland (nz1) starting tomorrow. :tada:
Lina (capacityops): This is a soft launch — small micro-pool, regional-only for now. Target customers: low-latency APAC partners and a few enterprise pilots.
Lina (capacityops): Key notes:
- Initial capacity: ~8 cards (shared micro-pool)
- Reservation window: first-come soft reservations via the portal, fairshare enforced
- Billing: normal dedicated pricing, plus temporary early-access credits for approved pilots
Lina (capacityops): Important policy change attached to this launch: we are tightening burst-window tagging to avoid cross-region over-provisioning. See below for CLI reservation snippet.
Marco (infra): Thanks Lina — infra will rotate the node images tonight and enable the G500X kernel. I'll add the zone to the topology map.
Marco (infra): @capacity-bot can you schedule a rolling capacity probe at 02:00 UTC?
capacity-bot: scheduled probe for nz1-g500x at 2026-04-15T02:00:00Z — will post results in #eng-ops.
Priya (sales-eng): Heads up to sales: if customers ask, prioritize enterprise pilots with compliance needs. We have two pilot slots reserved for Sales+Solutions.
Dan (billing): Quick note on metering: G500X will appear as `g500x.dedicated` in billing exports. Early-access credits will be applied as a negative line item labelled `G500X_EAP_CREDIT`.
Sasha (eng-sre): Can we add an automatic fallback route to L4e/gpu-compat in the same region in case of overload?
Lina (capacityops): Yes — default fallback will be `g500x-compatible` (same vCPU and memory profile) and will be documented in the rollout doc.
Lina (capacityops): Reservation CLI (for pilot teams):
```
# reserve a single G500X slot for a 4-hour window
redwood reserve --region nz1 --pool g500x-micro --start 2026-04-16T08:00:00Z --duration 4h --tag pilot:partnerX
```
Priya (sales-eng): Nice. Will circulate the pilot sign-up form after posting this.
Sasha (eng-sre): Will add canary routing to the observability dashboard and create an alert if latency 95p > 350ms for 3m.
Dan (billing): Also: remove preemptible promotions for this pool — it's dedicated-only.
Marco (infra): FYI: network egress in nz1 may be rate-limited at first; we'll document expected throughput per slot.
Lina (capacityops): Action items: 
- Marco: infra rollout + topology (ETA: tonight)
- Sasha: observability + fallback routing (ETA: EOD)
- Dan: billing flag + export name (ETA: EOD)
- Priya: pilot intake doc + customer comms (ETA: morning)
Lina (capacityops): If you need pilot access before the portal is live DM me.
Priya (sales-eng): :eyes: will do.
Sasha (eng-sre): :thumbsup: will follow up with the dashboard link.
Lina (capacityops): Thanks team — will post a formal rollout note with the portal link once infra probe shows green.
capacity-bot: rollout-note created: /docs/rollouts/g500x-nz1-preview — check perms before sharing externally.
Marco (infra): Noted, will check perms.
Lina (capacityops): End of thread.
